question: **Select the wrongly spelt word**.
solution: The correct answer is: "**paneche**". [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The correct spelling of the word is "**panache**". • **Panache **means flamboyant confidence or style. • **Example**: *She carried herself with panache, always making a stylish impression.* • The word is commonly used in fashion and lifestyle contexts. • The incorrect spelling of the word in the given options is a common mistake due to the French origin of the word. Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Palatial **means relating to a palace or resembling a palace in grandeur. (किसी महल से संबंधित या भव्यता में महल जैसा) • **Scurvy **is a disease caused by a deficiency of vitamin C. (विटामिन सी की कमी से होने वाला रोग) • **Oblique **means neither parallel nor at a right angle to a specified or implied line; slanting.
